title: Geom utility and indexed rendering support
summary: Adds indexed rendering support to Belfast core via BufferUsage.index, Mesh.setIndexBuffer, and automatic Draw.drawIndexed behavior. Introduces Geom.plane/sphere/cube generators that return positions, uvs, normals, and indices. Includes a new geom-indexed example and API/docs updates to document indexed workflows.
handoff_message: Antigravity review complete for "geom-indexed". In Cursor, ask the agent to use get_feedback_for_cursor for "geom-indexed".
cursor_notes: Geom.cube is now used by the render-to-texture example to remove duplicate cube geometry generation logic.
